title: The Birth of Ganesha: Creation of the Elephant-Headed God
description: Discover the captivating story of how Goddess Parvati created a fierce guardian from turmeric paste and sacred oils. Witness the fateful clash with Lord Shiva that led to the tragic birth of the beloved elephant-headed god. Explore the divine wrath and immediate regret that set the stage for an unforgettable resurrection.
